content: qupath-extension-braian (BraiAnDetect) has no documented area-classifier, density-map, or percent-positive-area feature -- it is strictly an object/cell-detection + object-classification extension (ChannelDetections + SimpleClassifier/OverlappingDetections). An area-based readout for compact-nuclei regions must be built on top of QuPath 0.6.0's own pixel-classification API (see PixelClassifiers.createThreshold), not the BraiAn extension.
